title: Debt and Extraction
author: Ivo Ishikawa
blurb: Emrys Amberdale, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
